question: With which of the following games is the Duckworth-Lewis-Stem method associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Duckworth-Lewis (DLS) method is used in cricket to calculate the target score for a match interrupted by weather or other circumstances.
 
• It was created by two Britishers-Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis.
 
• The method was formerly known as the Duckworth–Lewis method and it was adopted officially by the ICC in 1999.
 
• Tony Lewis, one of the men behind the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method used in weather-affected limited-overs cricket matches passed away in April 2020.
